Preparing your portfolio of evidence

For Part 1, use Units 1-3 to plan the site, organise assets and build linked HTML pages. For Part 2, style the site and test it at several widths using Units 4-5. For the final portfolio, use Units 6-7 to add behaviour and forms, improve search visibility and test the finished site.

The 2026 outline allocates 10% to ICE, 25% to Part 1, 30% to Part 2 and 35% to the final portfolio. Use your assessment brief and rubric for the submission requirements.
